line.en: the frankfurt christmas market is open 11:00 to 21:30 on friday, stalls from victoria square down new street. go after work.
line.de: der frankfurter weihnachtsmarkt in birmingham hat freitag von 11:00 bis 21:30 geöffnet, die stände reichen vom victoria square die new street hinunter. nach der arbeit hingehen.
line.tr: birmingham frankfurt noel pazarı cuma günü 11:00 ile 21:30 arası açık, tezgahlar victoria square'den new street boyunca uzanıyor. iş çıkışı uğra.

sparks.why: Birmingham Frankfurt Christmas Market runs 5 Nov to 24 Dec 2026; Friday hours 11:00 to 21:30 per the official BFCM 'Getting Here' page (thebfcm.co.uk) and the Express & Star market guide.
